title: Source-aware longitudinal trends
invariants: Never join a gap known to be incompatible or source-withdrawn
Long time intervals alone do not prove a missingness gap
For single point show marker only, never a trend
Outlier retains normal observed symbol unless validated semantics demand otherwise
No inferred zero from absent records
Exact x position must reflect time scale; avoid equal-spacing date categories
Reference bands only from matching source context
Selected point keyed to source observation ID and source-specific original record
Original value, unit, date/time, source assay, conversions and corrected date available on demand
Exact-value tabular alternative and keyboard navigation
Minimum 44x44 CSS px hit region per interactive observation
fixtureData: Fictional synthetic numerical design data only, located in source fixture JSON and SVG specimens; never render as user results
